# Supabase browser SDK

Version: `@supabase/supabase-js@2.57.4` (unchanged from the existing CDN import).

Official prebuilt UMD bundle: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.57.4/dist/umd/supabase.js

SHA-256: `7e94b62086deecef8c0ba3b38f514e2a1944ff6c81d92fb3ff967828c406c38f`. MIT license: `LICENSE-supabase.txt`.

`supabase-client.mjs` exposes the same createClient factory to existing ES modules. No build-time or runtime network download is required. To update, review the official release, replace the pinned file and checksum, preserve its license, and run the real-SDK offline bootstrap check.
